490	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun f => ((TypeCat.Hom.hom f : TypeCat.Fun _ _) : _ → _))
491	      ((DivFunctor π).map_id T)) z.1
492	  map_comp {T T' T''} g h := by
493	    ext z
494	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun f => ((TypeCat.Hom.hom f : TypeCat.Fun _ _) : _ → _))
495	      ((DivFunctor π).map_comp g h)) z.1
496	
497	/-- The canonical inclusion `Div^d_{X/S} ⟶ Div_{X/S}` — the subfunctor
498	inclusion of the degree-`d` slice, forgetting the constant-degree witness.
499	Componentwise injective (`divFunctorDegι_app_injective`). -/
500	noncomputable def divFunctorDegι (π : X ⟶ S) (d : ℕ) :
501	    DivFunctorDeg π d ⟶ DivFunctor π where
502	  app _ := TypeCat.ofHom Subtype.val
503	  naturality _ _ _ := rfl
504	
505	/-- The degree-`d` inclusion is componentwise injective: `DivFunctorDeg π d`
506	is a subfunctor of `DivFunctor π`. -/
507	theorem divFunctorDegι_app_injective (π : X ⟶ S) (d : ℕ)
508	    (T : (Over S)ᵒᵖ) :
509	    Function.Injective ((divFunctorDegι π d).app T : _ → _) :=
510	  fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext h
511	
512	/-! ## §5. The clopen degree decomposition -/
513	
514	namespace DivFamily
515	
516	variable {π : X ⟶ S}
517	
518	/-- The **degree-`d` locus** of a divisor family with locally constant fibre
519	degree: the clopen open subset `{t : T | deg D_t = d}` of the base.  The
520	local-constancy hypothesis is explicit (its discharge in the relative-curve
521	regime is the `HasLocallyConstantDivDeg` gate — see the module docstring). -/
522	def degLocus {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
523	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) (d : ℕ) : (T.left : Scheme.{u}).Opens :=
524	  ⟨{t | x.fiberDeg t = d}, hlc.isOpen_fiber d⟩
525	
526	/-- The degree-`d` locus is clopen. -/
527	theorem isClopen_degLocus {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
528	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) (d : ℕ) :
529	    IsClopen ((x.degLocus hlc d : TopologicalSpace.Opens (T.left : Scheme.{u})) :
530	      Set (T.left : Scheme.{u})) :=
531	  hlc.isClopen_fiber d
532	
533	/-- The degree loci cover the base: every point lies in the locus of its own
534	fibre degree. -/
535	theorem iSup_degLocus {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
536	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) :
537	    ⨆ d : ℕ, x.degLocus hlc d = ⊤ := by
538	  rw [eq_top_iff]
539	  intro t _
540	  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x.fiberDeg t, rfl⟩
541	
542	/-- The degree loci are pairwise disjoint: the fibre degree is a single
543	natural number at every point. -/
544	theorem degLocus_disjoint {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
545	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≠ d') :
546	    Disjoint (x.degLocus hlc d) (x.degLocus hlc d') := by
547	  refine disjoint_iff.mpr (TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext ?_)
548	  ext t
549	  simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_inf, Set.mem_inter_iff,
550	    TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
551	  intro h1 h2
552	  exact h ((show x.fiberDeg t = d from h1).symm.trans
553	    (show x.fiberDeg t = d' from h2))
554	
555	/-- The clopen immersion of the degree-`d` locus, as a morphism of `Over S`:
556	the piece of the clopen decomposition along which the family restricts to a
557	constant-degree family (`hasFiberDeg_pullbackAlong_degLocusHom`). -/
558	noncomputable def degLocusHom {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
559	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) (d : ℕ) :
560	    Over.mk ((x.degLocus hlc d).ι ≫ T.hom) ⟶ T :=
561	  Over.homMk (x.degLocus hlc d).ι rfl
562	
563	/-- **Every `T`-point of `Div` decomposes `T` into clopen constant-degree
564	pieces** (the honest form of `Div = ∐_d Div^d`, per-family half): the
565	restriction of the family to its degree-`d` locus has constant fibre degree
566	`d`.  Together with `iSup_degLocus`/`degLocus_disjoint`/`isClopen_degLocus`
567	this is the clopen decomposition the coproduct assembly (campaign G4)
568	consumes. -/
569	theorem hasFiberDeg_pullbackAlong_degLocusHom {T : Over S} (x : DivFamily π T)
570	    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) (d : ℕ) :
571	    (x.pullbackAlong (x.degLocusHom hlc d)).HasFiberDeg d := by
572	  intro t'
573	  rw [fiberDeg_pullbackAlong]
574	  exact t'.2
575	
576	end DivFamily
577	
578	/-- **`Div = ∐_d Div^d` on connected bases** (the honest functor-level form of
579	the degree decomposition — see the module docstring audit for why the
580	unrestricted presheaf statement is false): over a nonempty preconnected `T`,
581	the canonical comparison `Σ_d Div^d(T) → Div(T)` is a bijection, granted the
582	local constancy of fibre degrees (hypothesis-parametrized; in the AJC curve
583	regime it is the `HasLocallyConstantDivDeg` gate, see
584	`divFunctorDeg_sigma_bijective_of_gate`).  Injectivity is degree-uniqueness on
585	a nonempty base; surjectivity is "locally constant on preconnected = constant"
586	(`IsLocallyConstant.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace`). -/
587	theorem divFunctorDeg_sigma_bijective (π : X ⟶ S) {T : (Over S)ᵒᵖ}
588	    (hne : Nonempty (T.unop.left : Scheme.{u}))
589	    (hpc : PreconnectedSpace (T.unop.left : Scheme.{u}))
590	    (hlc : ∀ x : DivFamily π T.unop, IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg) :
591	    Function.Bijective fun p : (Σ d : ℕ, (DivFunctorDeg π d).obj T) =>
592	      (p.2.1 : (DivFunctor π).obj T) := by
593	  constructor
594	  · rintro ⟨d, z, hz⟩ ⟨d', z', hz'⟩ h
595	    obtain rfl : z = z' := h
596	    obtain rfl : d = d' := DivFamily.ClassHasFiberDeg.unique hne hz hz'
597	    rfl
598	  · intro z
599	    induction z using Quotient.ind with
600	    | _ x =>
601	      obtain ⟨t₀⟩ := hne
602	      haveI := hpc
603	      exact ⟨⟨x.fiberDeg t₀, ⟨Quotient.mk _ x,
604	        fun t => (hlc x).apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace t t₀⟩⟩, rfl⟩
605	
606	/-! ## §6. The local-constancy gate (relative-curve regime) -/
607	
608	/-- **Gate: divisor families on the curve have locally constant fibre degree**
609	(instance-free Prop-class, house `HasPicScheme` pattern — the deep heart is
610	deferred, never sorried).
611	
612	Mathematical content (TRUE at this pinned generality; Mumford, *Abelian
613	Varieties* II §5; Kleiman §3 Ex. `ex:DivC`): for a smooth proper relative
614	curve `C/k` and any `T`, a relative effective divisor `D ⊆ C ×_k T` is finite
615	flat over `T` (proper + quasi-finite: each `D_t` is the zero scheme of a
616	regular section of an invertible ideal on the curve `C_t`, hence
617	`0`-dimensional), so `q_* O_D` is finite locally free and its fibre rank —
618	`DivFamily.fiberDeg` — is Zariski-locally constant.  Discharge route: the
619	finiteness/rank half of the campaign's B3 rigid-pushforward engine plus
620	relative-dimension-1 quasi-finiteness; both are outside the current in-tree
621	substrate, hence the gate.
622	
623	Deliberately NOT stated for general `π : X ⟶ S`: in relative dimension `≥ 2`
624	the fibre rank of `O_{D_t}` can jump (only `χ(O_{D_t})` is locally constant),
625	which is why Kleiman filters `Div` by Hilbert polynomials in general.  All
626	decomposition theorems are also available in hypothesis-parametrized form
627	(explicit `IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg` argument), so this class is a pure
628	convenience pin at the AJC regime. -/
629	class HasLocallyConstantDivDeg {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
630	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] : Prop where
631	  /-- Every divisor family on the relative curve has Zariski-locally constant
632	  fibre degree. -/
633	  isLocallyConstant : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : DivFamily C.hom T),
634	    IsLocallyConstant x.fiberDeg
635	
636	/-- `Div_{C/k} = ∐_d Div^d_{C/k}` on nonempty connected bases, gated form:
637	the sigma comparison is bijective for the AJC curve, granted the
638	`HasLocallyConstantDivDeg` gate. -/
639	theorem divFunctorDeg_sigma_bijective_of_gate {k : Type u} [Field k]
640	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
641	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
642	    [HasLocallyConstantDivDeg C] {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
643	    (hne : Nonempty (T.unop.left : Scheme.{u}))
644	    (hpc : PreconnectedSpace (T.unop.left : Scheme.{u})) :
645	    Function.Bijective fun p : (Σ d : ℕ, (DivFunctorDeg C.hom d).obj T) =>
646	      (p.2.1 : (DivFunctor C.hom).obj T) :=
647	  divFunctorDeg_sigma_bijective C.hom hne hpc
648	    (fun x => HasLocallyConstantDivDeg.isLocallyConstant T.unop x)
649	
650	/-! ## §7. A2 — the degree-refined Abel map -/
651	
652	namespace PicScheme
653	
654	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
655	
656	/-- The degree-`d` relative-divisor functor of the AJC curve,
657	`Div^d_{C/k} := DivFunctorDeg C.hom d` — the A.2.c-side avatar of the general
658	degree slice, mirroring `divFunctor C = DivFunctor C.hom`
659	(`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`). -/
660	noncomputable def divFunctorDeg (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (d : ℕ) :
661	    (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1) :=
662	  DivFunctorDeg C.hom d
663	
664	/-- **The degree-refined Abel map** `A^d_{C/k} : Div^d_{C/k} ⟶ Pic^♯_{C/k}`
665	(Kleiman §3 Def. `dfn:Abel`, restricted to the degree-`d` slice): the
666	composite of the degree-`d` inclusion with the substantive Abel map
667	`abelMapWitness C`, so on points
668	
669	  `[D] ↦ [O(D)] = [I_D⁻¹] = -[ker q]`  (defining property `abelDeg_app_mk`).
670	
671	Sign convention (audit item 7-half): the divisor class maps to the **negative**
672	of the ideal-sheaf class; the fibre-degree ledger for the ideal side is
673	`DivFamily.fiberDeg_eq_finrank_fiber_cokernel` ("`ker q` has fibre degree
674	`−d`" in the rank vocabulary — module docstring audit).  The target is
675	deliberately the full `picSharp C`: carving out the degree-`d` Picard
676	subfunctor `picSharpDeg C d` is campaign milestone B4, and refactoring
677	`abelDeg` to corestrict onto it is part of that milestone, not this one. -/
678	noncomputable def abelDeg (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
679	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
680	    divFunctorDeg C d ⟶ picSharp C :=
681	  divFunctorDegι C.hom d ≫ abelMapWitness C
682	
683	/-- **Defining property of the degree-refined Abel map** (Kleiman §3
684	Def. `dfn:Abel`): on the class of a degree-`d` divisor family `⟨F, q⟩` it
685	returns `[O(D)] = [I_D⁻¹]`, the additive inverse of the class of the ideal
686	sheaf `I_D = ker q` — the `[D] ↦ -[ker q]` sign convention, verbatim
687	compatible with `abelMap_app_mk` through the inclusion. -/
688	theorem abelDeg_app_mk (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
689	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ)
690	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (x : DivFamily C.hom T.unop)
691	    (hx : DivFamily.ClassHasFiberDeg d
692	      (Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid C.hom T.unop) x)) :
693	    (abelDeg C d).app T ⟨Quotient.mk (DivFamily.setoid C.hom T.unop) x, hx⟩ =
694	      - Quotient.mk (PicSharp.relPicSetoid C.hom T.unop.hom)
695	        (⟨kernel x.q, x.kerLocallyTrivial⟩ :
696	          LineBundle.OnProduct C.hom T.unop.hom) :=
697	  rfl
698	
699	/-- The degree-refined Abel map factors the Abel map witness through the
700	degree-`d` inclusion — definitional, recorded for the blueprint. -/
701	theorem abelDeg_eq (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
702	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] (d : ℕ) :
703	    abelDeg C d = divFunctorDegι C.hom d ≫ abelMapWitness C :=
704	  rfl
705	
706	end PicScheme
707	
708	end Scheme
709	
710	end AlgebraicGeometry

6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotFunctorDef
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianQuot
9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ZariskiDescentRepresentability
10	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianZariskiSheaf
11	
12	/-!
13	# Representability of the relative Grassmannian (`thm:grassmannian_representable`)
14	
15	This file states and attacks the representability of the relative Grassmannian
16	functor `Grass(V, d) : (Sch/S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type 1` (`Scheme.Grassmannian`,
17	`QuotFunctorDef.lean`) by an `S`-scheme, for `V` a locally free
18	`O_S`-module of rank `r` and `1 ≤ d ≤ r` ([Nitsure] §1, Exercise (2);
19	blueprint `thm:grassmannian_representable`).
20	
21	The statement here **corrects** the earlier skeleton of `QuotFunctorDef.lean`,
22	which quantified over an arbitrary sheaf of modules `V` with no rank data:
23	that form is not the [Nitsure] theorem (whose hypotheses are `V` locally free
24	of rank `r ≥ d ≥ 1`) and is not known to be true for non-quasi-coherent `V`.
25	The universe is pinned to `Scheme.{0}`: the merged absolute chart construction
26	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme` / `.represents`,
27	`GrassmannianQuot.lean`) lives over the genuinely terminal `Spec ℤ` of
28	`Scheme.{0}`, and the relative theorem is obtained from it.
29	
30	## Contents
31	
32	* `Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule` / `Scheme.Grassmannian.congrIso` —
33	  transport of the Grassmannian functor along an isomorphism `V ≅ V'` of the
34	  classified module (pure functoriality, no pseudofunctor coherence).
35	* `Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.toRankQuotient` / `.ofRankQuotient` /
36	  `Scheme.Grassmannian.freeCompare` — for the free module `V = O_S^r`, the
37	  comparison `Grass(O_S^r, d) ≅ (Over.forget S)ᵒᵖ ⋙ Grass(r, d)` with the
38	  merged absolute Grassmannian functor, re-presenting the pulled-back free
39	  module through `Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso`.  Naturality is the free
40	  coherence `pullbackFreeIso_comp` of `GlueDescent.lean`.
41	* `Scheme.Grassmannian.prodRepresentableBy` — the absolute Grassmannian,
42	  pulled back to `Over S` along the forgetful functor, is representable by
43	  the product `S ⨯ Gr(d, r)` with its first projection (`Spec ℤ` is terminal
44	  in `Scheme.{0}`, so the product is the base change of `Gr(d, r)` to `S`).
45	* `Scheme.Grassmannian.representable_of_iso_free` — representability of
46	  `Grass(V, d)` for globally trivialised `V ≅ O_S^r` (complete proof).
47	* `Scheme.Grassmannian.representable` — the [Nitsure] statement, for `V`
48	  locally free of rank `r`: glue `representable_of_iso_free` over a
49	  trivialising cover of `(S, V)` by Zariski descent of representability
50	  (`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`, proved in
51	  `ZariskiDescentRepresentability.lean`); the remaining leaf is the sheaf
52	  axiom `Grassmannian.isZariskiSheaf`.
53	
54	## References
55	
56	Blueprint: `thm:grassmannian_representable`, `def:grassmannian_scheme`
57	(`blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`).
58	Source: [Nitsure], §1 (FGA Explained Ch. 5, arXiv:math/0504020).
59	-/
60	
61	set_option autoImplicit false
62	
63	universe u
64	
65	open CategoryTheory Limits
66	
67	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
68	
69	namespace Scheme
70	
71	/-! ## §1. Transport along an isomorphism of the classified module -/
72	
73	namespace LocallyFreeQuotient
74	
75	variable {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
76	
77	/-- Transport of a rank-`d` locally free quotient of `V'_T` along an
78	isomorphism `g : V ≅ V'` of the classified modules: precompose the quotient
79	map with the pulled-back isomorphism.  Underlies the invariance
80	`Scheme.Grassmannian.congrIso` of the Grassmannian functor. -/
81	noncomputable def congrModule {V V' : S.Modules} (g : V ≅ V') {d : ℕ} {T : Over S}
82	    (x : LocallyFreeQuotient V d T) : LocallyFreeQuotient V' d T where
83	  F := x.F
84	  q := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ x.q
85	  epi :=
86	    @CategoryTheory.epi_comp _ _ _ _ _
87	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.hom).mapIso g).inv inferInstance
88	      x.q x.epi
89	  locFree := x.locFree
90	
91	omit [IsLocallyNoetherian S] in
92	/-- The module-iso transport respects the equivalence of quotients. -/
93	lemma congrModule_rel {V V' : S.Modules} (g : V ≅ V') {d : ℕ} {T : Over S}
94	    {x y : LocallyFreeQuotient V d T} (h : x.Rel y) :
95	    (congrModule g x).Rel (congrModule g y) := by
96	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
97	  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
98	  change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ x.q) ≫ f.hom
99	    = ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ y.q
100	  rw [Category.assoc]
101	  exact congrArg (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ ·) hf
102	
103	end LocallyFreeQuotient
104	
105	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
106	/-- **Invariance of the Grassmannian functor under isomorphism of the
107	classified module**: an isomorphism `g : V ≅ V'` of sheaves of modules on `S`
108	induces an isomorphism `Grass(V, d) ≅ Grass(V', d)` of the relative
109	Grassmannian functors.  Pure functoriality: the components transport a
110	quotient along `congrModule`, and naturality is the naturality of the
111	pullback pseudofunctor comparisons in the module variable. -/
112	noncomputable def Grassmannian.congrIso {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
113	    {V V' : S.Modules} (g : V ≅ V') (d : ℕ) :
114	    Scheme.Grassmannian V d ≅ Scheme.Grassmannian V' d :=
115	  NatIso.ofComponents
116	    (fun T => Equiv.toIso
117	      { toFun := Quotient.map (LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule g)
118	          (fun _ _ h => LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule_rel g h)
119	        invFun := Quotient.map (LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule g.symm)
120	          (fun _ _ h => LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule_rel g.symm h)
121	        left_inv := fun z => by
122	          induction z using Quotient.ind with
123	          | _ x =>
124	            refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
125	            change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g.symm).inv ≫
126	                (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ x.q))) ≫ 𝟙 _
127	              = x.q
128	            rw [Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc]
129	            rw [show (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g.symm).inv ≫
130	                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv)
131	              = 𝟙 _ by
132	                rw [Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
133	                  ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]]
134	            exact Category.id_comp x.q
135	        right_inv := fun z => by
136	          induction z using Quotient.ind with
137	          | _ x =>
138	            refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
139	            change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫
140	                (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g.symm).inv ≫ x.q))) ≫ 𝟙 _
141	              = x.q
142	            rw [Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc]
143	            rw [show ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫
144	                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g.symm).inv))
145	              = 𝟙 _ by
146	                rw [Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
147	                  ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]]
148	            exact Category.id_comp x.q })
149	    (fun {T T'} ψ => by
150	      ext z
151	      induction z using Quotient.ind with
152	      | _ x =>
153	        change Quotient.mk _ (LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule g
154	            (LocallyFreeQuotient.pullbackAlong ψ.unop x))
155	          = Quotient.mk _ (LocallyFreeQuotient.pullbackAlong ψ.unop
156	            (LocallyFreeQuotient.congrModule g x))
157	        refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
158	        change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T'.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫
159	            (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ.unop) V).inv ≫
160	            (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map x.q) ≫ 𝟙 _
161	          = (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ.unop) V').inv ≫
162	            (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map
163	              (((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.unop.hom).mapIso g).inv ≫ x.q)
164	        rw [Category.comp_id, Functor.map_comp]
165	        rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
166	        refine congrArg (· ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map x.q) ?_
167	        -- naturality of the triangle comparison in the module variable at `g.inv`
168	        simpa only [pullbackTriangleIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc,
169	          Functor.mapIso_inv, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.comp_map]
170	          using ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Over.w ψ.unop)).inv ≫
171	            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ψ.unop.left T.unop.hom).inv).naturality g.inv)
172	
173	/-! ## §2. The free case: comparison with the merged absolute Grassmannian
174	
175	For the free module `V = O_S^r` the relative Grassmannian functor agrees with
176	the merged absolute Grassmannian functor `Grass(r, d)`

248	module and the merged absolute Grassmannian functor. -/
249	noncomputable def freeCompareEquiv (d r : ℕ) (T : Over S) :
250	    Quotient (Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.setoid
251	      (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r)) d T) ≃
252	    Quotient (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.rqSetoid r d T.left) where
253	  toFun := Quotient.map Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.toRankQuotient
254	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.toRankQuotient_rel h)
255	  invFun := Quotient.map Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.ofRankQuotient
256	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.ofRankQuotient_rel h)
257	  left_inv := fun z => by
258	    induction z using Quotient.ind with
259	    | _ x =>
260	      refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
261	      change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).hom ≫
262	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫ x.q)) ≫ 𝟙 _
263	        = x.q
264	      rw [Category.comp_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
265	  right_inv := fun z => by
266	    induction z using Quotient.ind with
267	    | _ x =>
268	      refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
269	      change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫
270	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).hom ≫ x.q)) ≫ 𝟙 _

276	/-- **Free-pullback coherence for the quotient re-presentation** — the
277	naturality core of `freeCompare`: pulling back along `ψ : T' ⟶ T` in `Over S`
278	commutes with the re-presentation of the source through
279	`Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso`.  Assembled from the congruence absorptions
280	and the free coherence `pullbackFreeIso_comp` of `GlueDescent.lean`. -/
281	lemma freeCompare_naturality_core {r : ℕ} {T T' : Over S} (ψ : T' ⟶ T) :
282	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T'.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫
283	      (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
284	        (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r))).inv
285	    = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso ψ.left (Fin r)).inv ≫
286	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.left).map
287	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).inv := by
288	  -- Step A: absorb the `pullbackCongr` cast into the free-pullback comparison.
289	  have hA : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T'.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫
290	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Over.w ψ)).inv.app
291	        (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r))
292	      = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso (ψ.left ≫ T.hom) (Fin r)).inv := by
293	    rw [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr_inv_app (Over.w ψ)]
294	    rw [← Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr_hom_app (Over.w ψ).symm]
295	    exact Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso_inv_congr (Over.w ψ).symm (Fin r)
296	  -- Step B: invert the free coherence `pullbackFreeIso_comp`.
297	  have hB : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso (ψ.left ≫ T.hom) (Fin r)).inv ≫
298	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ψ.left T.hom).inv.app
299	        (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r))
300	      = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso ψ.left (Fin r)).inv ≫
301	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.left).map
302	          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).inv := by
303	    rw [← cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.left).map
304	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.hom (Fin r)).hom)]
305	    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
306	      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
307	    rw [Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_inv_app_free_map ψ.left T.hom (Fin r)]
308	    exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc _ _
309	  simp only [pullbackTriangleIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.app_inv]
310	  rw [← Category.assoc, hA]
311	  exact hB

314	/-- **Comparison with the absolute Grassmannian** for the free module: the
315	relative Grassmannian functor of `O_S^r` is naturally isomorphic to the merged
316	absolute Grassmannian functor `Grass(r, d)` evaluated on underlying schemes.
317	Components are `freeCompareEquiv`; naturality is
318	`freeCompare_naturality_core`. -/
319	noncomputable def freeCompare (d r : ℕ) :
320	    Scheme.Grassmannian (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r)) d ≅
321	      (Over.forget S).op ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.functor d r :=
322	  NatIso.ofComponents
323	    (fun T => Equiv.toIso (freeCompareEquiv d r T.unop))
324	    (fun {T T'} ψ => by
325	      ext z
326	      induction z using Quotient.ind with
327	      | _ x =>
328	        change Quotient.mk _ (Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.toRankQuotient
329	            (Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.pullbackAlong ψ.unop x))
330	          = Quotient.mk _ (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.rqPullback ψ.unop.left
331	            (Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.toRankQuotient x))
332	        refine Quotient.sound ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
333	        change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T'.unop.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫
334	            (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ.unop)
335	              (SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r))).inv ≫
336	            (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map x.q) ≫ 𝟙 _
337	          = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso ψ.unop.left (Fin r)).inv ≫
338	            (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map
339	              ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.unop.hom (Fin r)).inv ≫ x.q)
340	        rw [Category.comp_id, Functor.map_comp]
341	        rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
342	        exact congrArg (· ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map x.q)

345	/-! ## §3. Representability of the pulled-back absolute functor
346	
347	`Scheme.{0}` has binary products (`Spec ℤ` is terminal, pullbacks exist), so
348	the forgetful functor `Over S ⥤ Sch` has the right adjoint `Over.star S`,
349	`Y ↦ (S ⨯ Y, fst)`.  The base change of the absolute Grassmannian to `S` is
350	`(Over.star S).obj Gr(d, r)`, and the adjunction transports the absolute
351	representability (`AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.represents`) to `Over S`. -/
352	
353	/-- The merged absolute Grassmannian functor, restricted to `Over S` along the
354	forgetful functor, is representable by the base change
355	`(Over.star S).obj Gr(d, r) = (S ⨯ Gr(d, r), fst)` of the absolute
356	Grassmannian scheme. -/
357	noncomputable def prodRepresentableBy (S : Scheme.{0}) (d r : ℕ)
358	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
359	    ((Over.forget S).op ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.functor d r).RepresentableBy
360	      ((Over.star S).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r)) where
361	  homEquiv {T} :=
362	    ((Over.forgetAdjStar S).homEquiv T
363	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r)).symm.trans
364	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.represents d r hd hdr).homEquiv
365	  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f g := by
366	    change (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.represents d r hd hdr).homEquiv
367	        (((Over.forgetAdjStar S).homEquiv _ _).symm (f ≫ g)) = _
368	    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
369	    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.represents d r hd hdr).homEquiv_comp
370	      ((Over.forget S).map f) (((Over.forgetAdjStar S).homEquiv _ _).symm g)
371	
372	/-! ## §4. Representability: trivialised and locally free cases -/
373	
374	/-- **Representability of the relative Grassmannian, trivialised case**: for a
375	globally trivialised module `V ≅ O_S^r` on a locally noetherian `S` and
376	`1 ≤ d ≤ r`, the functor `Grass(V, d)` is representable by the base change
377	`S ⨯ Gr(d, r)` of the absolute Grassmannian.  Complete proof: transport the
378	representability of the pulled-back absolute functor
379	(`prodRepresentableBy`) along the comparisons `congrIso` and `freeCompare`. -/
380	theorem representable_of_iso_free {V : S.Modules} {r : ℕ}
381	    (e : V ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r)) {d : ℕ}
382	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
383	    ∃ (Y : Over S), Nonempty ((Scheme.Grassmannian V d).RepresentableBy Y) :=
384	  ⟨(Over.star S).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r),
385	    ⟨(prodRepresentableBy S d r hd hdr).ofIso
386	      ((Scheme.Grassmannian.congrIso e d ≪≫ freeCompare d r).symm)⟩⟩
387	
388	end Grassmannian

401	
402	For a base morphism `j : S' ⟶ S`, restricting the relative Grassmannian
403	functor along `Over.map j : Over S' ⥤ Over S` classifies quotients of the
404	restricted module: the pseudofunctor comparison `pullbackComp` re-presents a
405	quotient of `(T.hom ≫ j)^* V` as a quotient of `T.hom^* (j^* V)`, naturally
406	in `T` (`restrictIso`).  Combined with the trivialised case this yields local
407	representability over each member of a trivialising cover of `(S, V)`

510	    rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w ψ]

532	    (fun {T T'} ψ => by

539	            (restrictBase j x))

545	              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V)).inv ≫
546	            (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map
547	              (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp T.unop.hom j).app V).hom ≫ x.q)
548	        rw [Category.comp_id, Functor.map_comp]
549	        rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
550	        exact congrArg (· ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ψ.unop.left).map x.q)
551	          (restrictBase_naturality_core j V ψ.unop))
552	
553	/-- **Local representability over a trivialising open**: over an open
554	`U ⊆ S` on which `V` trivialises, the restriction of the Grassmannian
555	functor to `Sch/U` is representable.  Complete proof: compose the
556	restriction comparison `restrictIso` with the trivialised case
557	`representable_of_iso_free` (the trivialisation index is re-normalised from
558	`ULift (Fin r)` to `Fin r` through the free functor). -/
559	theorem representable_restrict {V : S.Modules} {r : ℕ} (U : S.Opens)
560	    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj V ≅
561	      SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{0} (Fin r)))
562	    {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
563	    ∃ Y : Over U.toScheme,
564	      Nonempty (((Over.map U.ι).op ⋙ Scheme.Grassmannian V d).RepresentableBy Y) := by
565	  obtain ⟨Y, ⟨hY⟩⟩ := representable_of_iso_free
566	    (e ≪≫ (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
567	      (Equiv.toIso Equiv.ulift)) hd hdr
568	  exact ⟨Y, ⟨hY.ofIso (restrictIso U.ι V d).symm⟩⟩
569	
570	/-- **The Grassmannian functor is a Zariski sheaf** ([Nitsure] §1; the
571	implicit locality behind the chart construction).  Families of rank-`d`
572	locally free quotients glue along an open cover of the parameter scheme:
573	the target sheaves glue by descent of sheaves of modules along the cover
574	(the `Scheme.Modules.glue` engine of `GlueDescent.lean` at the glue datum of
575	the cover), the quotient maps glue through the descent-equalizer lift
576	`Scheme.Modules.glueLift`, local freeness and epi-ness are local, and the
577	glued family is unique up to the equivalence `ker q = ker q'` because an
578	isomorphism of quotients commuting with the epimorphisms is unique when it
579	exists, so the local comparison isos satisfy the descent cocycle for free.
580	Proved in `GrassmannianZariskiSheaf.lean`
581	(`Scheme.grassmannian_isZariskiSheafOver`). -/
582	theorem isZariskiSheaf (V : S.Modules) (d : ℕ) :
583	    IsZariskiSheafOver (Scheme.Grassmannian V d) :=
584	  Scheme.grassmannian_isZariskiSheafOver V d
585	
586	/-- **Representability of the Grassmannian** (`thm:grassmannian_representable`,
587	[Nitsure] §1 "Construction of Grassmannian", Exercise (2)): for a locally
588	noetherian `S`, a locally free `O_S`-module `V` of rank `r`, and `1 ≤ d ≤ r`,
589	the functor `Grass(V, d)` is representable by an `S`-scheme.  Proof: `V`
590	trivialises on an open cover of `S`; over each member the functor is
591	representable (`representable_restrict`, via the merged absolute chart
592	construction), and representability descends along the cover
593	(`Scheme.representable_of_openCover`) since the Grassmannian functor is a
594	Zariski sheaf (`isZariskiSheaf`). -/
595	theorem representable {V : S.Modules} {r : ℕ}
596	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r) {d : ℕ}
597	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
598	    ∃ (Y : Over S), Nonempty ((Scheme.Grassmannian V d).RepresentableBy Y) := by
599	  obtain ⟨ι, U, hU, hloc⟩ := hV
600	  refine representable_of_openCover (Scheme.Grassmannian V d)
601	    (isZariskiSheaf V d) U hU (fun i => ?_)
602	  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hloc i
603	  exact representable_restrict (U i) e hd hdr
604

12	/-!
13	# The identity component of the Picard scheme
14	
15	Let `G` be a `k`-group scheme locally of finite type. Its **identity
16	component** `G⁰` is the connected component of `|G|` containing the image of
17	the identity section. It is an open and closed subgroup scheme of `G`, of
18	finite type and geometrically irreducible over `k`, and its formation
19	commutes with extension of the base field (Kleiman, §5, Lem.~`lem:agps`).
20	
21	This file develops that substrate for an arbitrary `k`-group scheme (§1) and
22	then specialises it to `G = Pic_{C/k}`, the Picard scheme of a smooth proper
23	geometrically integral curve `C/k` (§2), obtaining `Pic⁰_{C/k}` together with
24	the degree map `Pic_{C/k}(k) → ℤ` (§3) whose kernel it cuts out on
25	`k`-points (§4). For `C` of positive genus, `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is the Jacobian
26	variety of `C`.
27	
28	## Main results
29	
30	- `AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme.IdentityComponent` — the identity component
31	  `G⁰` of a `k`-group scheme `G` locally of finite type, as a `k`-scheme (an
32	  object of `Over (Spec k)`): the open subscheme of `G` carried by the
33	  connected component of the image of the identity section.
34	- `AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.isOpenSubgroupScheme` —
35	  the inclusion `G⁰ ↪ G` is both an open and a closed immersion.
36	- `AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.isSubgroupHomomorphism` —
37	  `G⁰` inherits the group-object structure of `G`.
38	- `AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.baseChangeIso` — for a
39	  field extension `K/k`, the base change `(G⁰)_K` is isomorphic to `(G_K)⁰`.
40	- `AlgebraicGeometry.GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible`
41	  — `G⁰` is of finite type and geometrically irreducible over `k`.
42	- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0Scheme` — the identity component
43	  `Pic⁰_{C/k}` of the Picard scheme.
44	- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PicScheme.degree` — the degree map
45	  `Pic_{C/k}(k) → ℤ`, the leading coefficient of the Hilbert polynomial of a
46	  representing invertible sheaf relative to a fixed degree-one polarisation
47	  `O_C(1)`.
48	- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0Scheme.finrank_eq_genus` — the dimension of
49	  `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is the genus of `C`.
50	- `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pic0Scheme.kPoints_iff_kerDegree` — a `k`-point
51	  of `Pic_{C/k}` factors through `Pic⁰_{C/k}` iff its degree vanishes.
52	
53	The abelian-variety identification of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` (smooth, proper,
54	geometrically irreducible `k`-group scheme of dimension `g(C)`) is assembled
55	in the sibling file `Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean`.
56	
57	## Remaining obligations
58	
59	The §1 substrate for an abstract `k`-group scheme is unconditional. Three
60	statements of §3–§4 are still open; all three depend on the invertible sheaf
61	representing a `k`-point of `Pic_{C/k}`, which rests on the representability
62	of the relative Picard functor (`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`):
63	
64	- `PicScheme.degree`: the value should be the leading coefficient of the
65	  Hilbert polynomial `Φ_L(n) = χ(C, L ⊗ O_C(n)) = n · deg L + 1 - g` of a
66	  representing sheaf `L`, which is independent of the choice of `L`.
67	- `Pic0Scheme.finrank_eq_genus`: the equality
68	  `dim Pic⁰_{C/k} = dim_k H¹(C, O_C) = g(C)`, which follows from
69	  Kleiman~§5 Cor.~`cor:sm` once the identity component is known to be smooth.
70	- `Pic0Scheme.kPoints_iff_kerDegree`: the identification of the `k`-points of
71	  `Pic⁰_{C/k}` with the degree-zero classes.
72	
73	## References
74	
75	- Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_IdentityComponent.tex`.
76	- Kleiman, "The Picard scheme", §5, Lem.~`lem:agps` (identity component
77	  substrate) + Prp.~`prp:pic0` (specialisation to `Pic_{C/k}`) +
78	  Thm.~`th:qpp&p` (quasi-projectivity/projectivity) + Cor.~`cor:sm`
79	  (smoothness/dimension) + Ex.~`ex:jac` + Rmk.~`rmk:Jac`
80	  (arXiv:math/0504020 pp. 36, 38, 47, 50–51);
81	- Milne, "Abelian Varieties" (course notes, 2008), §III.1
82	  (def. of abelian variety, p. 8; dimension equals genus, Rmk. III.1.4(e),
83	  p. 86).
84	-/

94	/-! ## §1. The identity component of a group scheme — abstract substrate
95	
96	The identity component is an abstract feature of `k`-group schemes locally of
97	finite type. We package the definition + open-and-closed-subgroup-scheme
98	structure in the `GroupScheme` namespace so they are reusable outside the
99	Picard context.
100	
101	In this project, a "`k`-group scheme" is encoded as an
102	`Over (Spec (.of k))`-object `G` carrying a `[GrpObj G]` instance (the
103	group-object structure in the over-category). The locally-of-finite-type
104	hypothesis is the `[LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]` instance on the structural
105	morphism to the base.
106	
107	Blueprint references: `def:identity_component_group_scheme` +
108	`thm:identity_component_open_subgroup` (Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`). -/
109	
110	namespace GroupScheme
111	
112	/-- In a **Noetherian** topological space `α`, the set of connected
113	components is finite.
114	
115	Proof: the map `irreducibleComponents α → ConnectedComponents α` sending each
116	irreducible component `C` to the connected component of an arbitrary chosen
117	point of `C` is well-defined (because `C` is preconnected, hence contained in
118	a single connected component) and surjective (because every point lies in
119	some irreducible component, namely `irreducibleComponent x`, which is a
120	subset of `connectedComponent x`). The source is finite by
121	`TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents`, so the
122	target is finite by `Finite.of_surjective`. -/
123	private lemma noetherianSpace_finite_connectedComponents
124	    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace α] :
125	    Finite (ConnectedComponents α) := by
126	  classical
127	  have hfin : (irreducibleComponents α).Finite :=
128	    TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
129	  haveI : Finite ↥(irreducibleComponents α) := hfin.to_subtype
130	  refine Finite.of_surjective
131	    (fun C : ↥(irreducibleComponents α) =>
132	      (ConnectedComponents.mk : α → ConnectedComponents α)
133	        ((C.property : Maximal IsIrreducible C.val).prop.nonempty.some)) ?_
134	  intro c
135	  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ConnectedComponents.surjective_coe c
136	  refine ⟨⟨irreducibleComponent x, irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x⟩, ?_⟩
137	  rw [ConnectedComponents.coe_eq_coe]
138	  refine (connectedComponent_eq ?_).symm
139	  exact irreducibleComponent_subset_connectedComponent
140	    (isIrreducible_irreducibleComponent (x := x)).nonempty.some_mem
141	
142	/-- In a **Noetherian** topological space `α`, each connected component is
143	open.
144	
145	Proof: `ConnectedComponents α` is totally disconnected
146	(`ConnectedComponents.totallyDisconnectedSpace`), hence T1
147	(`TotallyDisconnectedSpace.t1Space`), and finite by
148	`noetherianSpace_finite_connectedComponents`. A finite T1 space is discrete
149	(`Finite.instDiscreteTopology`), so the singleton
150	`{ConnectedComponents.mk x}` is open in the quotient. The preimage of this
151	singleton under the continuous quotient map `ConnectedComponents.mk` is
152	`connectedComponent x` (`connectedComponents_preimage_singleton`), which is
153	therefore open. -/
154	private lemma noetherianSpace_isOpen_connectedComponent
155	    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace α]
156	    (x : α) :
157	    IsOpen (connectedComponent x) := by
158	  haveI : Finite (ConnectedComponents α) := noetherianSpace_finite_connectedComponents
159	  haveI : DiscreteTopology (ConnectedComponents α) := inferInstance
160	  have h := (isOpen_discrete
161	    ({(ConnectedComponents.mk x : ConnectedComponents α)} : Set _)).preimage
162	    ConnectedComponents.continuous_coe
163	  rwa [connectedComponents_preimage_singleton] at h
164	
165	/-- The **`LocallyConnectedSpace` instance** for the underlying topological
166	space of a `k`-scheme `G.left` whose structural morphism
167	`G.hom : G.left ⟶ Spec k` is locally of finite type.
168	
169	The substantive content is EGA I 6.1.9: a locally Noetherian topological
170	space has open connected components — equivalently, is locally connected.
171	Pushed through the chain: `Spec k` is Noetherian (a field has Noetherian
172	spectrum); `LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom + IsLocallyNoetherian (Spec k) ⟹
173	IsLocallyNoetherian G.left` (Mathlib's
174	`AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian`); and the
175	implication `IsLocallyNoetherian X ⟹ LocallyConnectedSpace X.toTopCat`
176	comes from `noetherianSpace_finite_connectedComponents` together with
177	`noetherianSpace_isOpen_connectedComponent` above.
178	
179	The classical proof: each point `y ∈ G.left` has an open affine
180	neighbourhood `W = Spec R` with `R` Noetherian, hence `|W|` is a Noetherian
181	topological space; in a Noetherian space, each `connectedComponent y` is
182	clopen (finite irreducible components ⟹ finite connected components ⟹
183	finite T1 quotient ⟹ discrete quotient ⟹ singletons clopen in quotient ⟹
184	preimages clopen). Pulled back along the open inclusion `W ↪ G.left`,
185	this gives an open connected neighbourhood of `y` inside any open `F`
186	containing `y`. -/
187	private instance identityComponent_locallyConnectedSpace
188	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
189	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
190	    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
191	    LocallyConnectedSpace G.left := by
192	  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian G.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian G.hom
193	  rw [locallyConnectedSpace_iff_subsets_isOpen_isConnected]
194	  intro x F hF
195	  -- Extract an open neighbourhood `T ⊆ F` of `x`.
196	  obtain ⟨T, hTF, hT, hxT⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hF
197	  -- Find an affine open `W ⊆ T` with `x ∈ W`.
198	  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWT⟩ :=
199	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := G.left) (U := ⟨T, hT⟩) hxT
200	  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(G.left, W) :=
201	    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨W, hW⟩
202	  haveI hNoethW : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace ↥W :=
203	    noetherianSpace_of_isAffineOpen W hW
204	  -- Inside `W` (Noetherian) the connected component of `x` is open; its image
205	  -- under the open inclusion `W ↪ G.left` is the connected open neighbourhood
206	  -- we want.
207	  let xW : ↥W := ⟨x, hxW⟩
208	  refine ⟨(Subtype.val : ↥W → G.left) '' connectedComponent xW, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
209	  · rintro _ ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
210	    exact hTF (hWT z.2)
211	  · exact W.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val _
212	      (noetherianSpace_isOpen_connectedComponent xW)
213	  · exact ⟨xW, mem_connectedComponent, rfl⟩
214	  · exact isConnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
215	
216	/-- The image of the identity section `e : Spec k → G` (well-defined as a
217	single point of `|G|` because `Spec k` is a topological singleton). -/
218	private noncomputable def identitySectionPoint
219	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] : G.left :=
220	  ((MonObj.one (X := G)).left.base :
221	      ↥(Spec (.of k)) → G.left) (default : Spec (.of k))
222	
223	/-- The **clopen carrier `Set`** of the identity component of a `k`-group
224	scheme `G` locally of finite type, packaged as a `G.left.Opens`.
225	
226	The carrier set is `connectedComponent x`
227	for `x = e(*)` the image of the identity section
228	(`identitySectionPoint G`); openness is `isOpen_connectedComponent` which
229	needs the `identityComponent_locallyConnectedSpace` instance above
230	(EGA I 6.1.9). -/
231	private noncomputable def identityComponentCarrier {k : Type u} [Field k]
232	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
233	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
234	    G.left.Opens :=
235	  ⟨connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G), isOpen_connectedComponent⟩
236	
237	/-- The **identity component** `G^0` of a `k`-group scheme `G` locally of
238	finite type.
239	
240	Encoded as a `k`-scheme: an object of `Over (Spec (.of k))`, carrying the
241	intended substantive identity "this is the connected component of `|G|`
242	containing the identity section `e`, equipped with the open-subscheme
243	structure inherited from `G`". The associated open immersion
244	`IdentityComponent G ⟶ G` is the content of
245	`IdentityComponent.isOpenSubgroupScheme`.
246	
247	Concretely, `IdentityComponent G` is built from `identityComponentCarrier G`:
248	the open subscheme of `G` whose underlying topological space is the connected
249	component of `|G|` through the image of the identity section, with the
250	inherited structure morphism `(identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom`. The
251	carrier is `connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G)`, open by
252	`isOpen_connectedComponent` under the
253	`identityComponent_locallyConnectedSpace` instance (EGA I 6.1.9: locally
254	Noetherian spaces have open connected components). -/
255	noncomputable def IdentityComponent {k : Type u} [Field k]
256	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
257	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
258	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
259	  Over.mk ((identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom)
260	
261	/-- **The identity component is an open and closed subgroup scheme.**
262	
263	The bundled statement of Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`~(3): the identity
264	component `G^0 = IdentityComponent G` of a `k`-group scheme `G` locally of
265	finite type comes with a morphism `IdentityComponent G ⟶ G` (in
266	`Over (Spec (.of k))`) whose underlying scheme morphism is both an open
267	immersion and a closed immersion (i.e. the inclusion of a clopen
268	subscheme).
269	
270	The remaining parts of Kleiman's conclusion — the group-subscheme property
271	(the inclusion is a homomorphism of `k`-group schemes), finite-type-ness over
272	`k` (`LocallyOfFiniteType` + quasi-compactness), geometric irreducibility and
273	base-change-commutation — are stated separately as
274	`IdentityComponent.isSubgroupHomomorphism`,
275	`IdentityComponent.isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible` and
276	`IdentityComponent.baseChangeIso`.
277	
278	The inclusion morphism is `Over.homMk (identityComponentCarrier G).ι`, with
279	the over-category compatibility holding by definition of
280	`IdentityComponent G`. The `.left` of this morphism is
281	`(identityComponentCarrier G).ι`, an open immersion by the global
282	`Scheme.Opens.instIsOpenImmersionι` instance. For the closed-immersion
283	half we apply `IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion` to the open immersion
284	and reduce to `IsClosed (↑(identityComponentCarrier G) : Set _)`, which holds
285	because the carrier is a connected component and connected components are
286	closed. -/
287	theorem IdentityComponent.isOpenSubgroupScheme {k : Type u} [Field k]
288	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
289	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
290	    Nonempty {f : IdentityComponent G ⟶ G //
291	        IsOpenImmersion f.left ∧ IsClosedImmersion f.left} := by
292	  -- Over-category compatibility for the underlying open immersion.
293	  have hcomp : (identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom = (IdentityComponent G).hom := by
294	    simp [IdentityComponent]
295	  -- The over-morphism witness.
296	  let f : IdentityComponent G ⟶ G :=
297	    Over.homMk (U := IdentityComponent G) (V := G) (identityComponentCarrier G).ι hcomp
298	  refine ⟨⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
299	  · -- `f.left = (identityComponentCarrier G).ι` (definitionally; `Over.homMk_left` simp).
300	    -- An open immersion by `Scheme.Opens.instIsOpenImmersionι`.
301	    change IsOpenImmersion (identityComponentCarrier G).ι
302	    infer_instance
303	  · -- `f.left = (identityComponentCarrier G).ι` is a preimmersion (open immersion ⟹
304	    -- immersion ⟹ preimmersion). Its range is the carrier set (`Scheme.Opens.range_ι`),
305	    -- and closure of that connected subset is itself (Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`~(3):
306	    -- the connected component through the identity is closed in `|G|`).
307	    change IsClosedImmersion (identityComponentCarrier G).ι
308	    apply IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion
309	    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
310	    -- The carrier set is `connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G)`, which is
311	    -- closed by `isClopen_connectedComponent.1` (with the
312	    -- `identityComponent_locallyConnectedSpace` instance providing the closedness
313	    -- half of EGA I 6.1.9: connected components of a locally Noetherian topological
314	    -- space are clopen).
315	    change IsClosed (connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G))
316	    exact isClopen_connectedComponent.1
317	
318	/-! ### Connectedness substrate for the identity component
319	
320	The group-structure inheritance and base-change-commutation arguments rest on
321	Stacks Tag 04KU / EGA IV₂ 4.5.14 (a connected `k`-scheme with a `k`-rational
322	section is geometrically connected), combined with Mathlib's
323	`ConnectedSpace (pullback f g)` instance for
324	`[GeometricallyConnected f] [UniversallyOpen f] [ConnectedSpace Y]`.
325	
326	The carrier of the identity component is connected by construction
327	(`identityComponentCarrier_connectedSpace` below), and the bridge
328	"`ConnectedSpace X` + section ⟹ `GeometricallyConnected f`" is proved in the
329	sibling module `Picard/GeometricallyConnectedSection.lean`, applied here in
330	`geometricallyConnected_of_connected_of_section`. On top of these,
331	`isSubgroupHomomorphism` (group-structure inheritance) and `baseChangeIso`
332	(clopen-image identification) follow; the latter closes via
333	`CategoryTheory.Over.grpObjMkPullbackSnd` together with the carrier
334	identification `fst⁻¹(G⁰) = (G_K)⁰` (clopen ⊇, preconnected-range ⊆). -/
335	
336	/-- The **identity component carrier** has connected underlying topological
337	space.
338	
339	The carrier is defined as `connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G)`
340	in `|G|` (a `G.left.Opens`), and its subspace topology coincides with the
341	open-subscheme topology; the subspace is connected because the connected
342	component is preconnected (Mathlib's `isPreconnected_connectedComponent`)
343	and nonempty (contains the identity point `identitySectionPoint G`). -/
344	private instance identityComponentCarrier_connectedSpace
345	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
346	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
347	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
348	    ConnectedSpace ((identityComponentCarrier G : G.left.Opens) : Type _) := by
349	  haveI : PreconnectedSpace ((identityComponentCarrier G : G.left.Opens) : Type _) :=
350	    Subtype.preconnectedSpace isPreconnected_connectedComponent
351	  exact ⟨⟨⟨identitySectionPoint G, mem_connectedComponent⟩⟩⟩
352	
353	/-- The **identity component** `IdentityComponent G` has connected underlying
354	topological space.
355	
356	By definition `(IdentityComponent G).left` is the open subscheme
357	`identityComponentCarrier G : G.left.Opens` regarded as a scheme; its
358	underlying topological space coincides definitionally with the carrier's
359	subspace topology, so `ConnectedSpace` transports via
360	`identityComponentCarrier_connectedSpace` above.
361	
362	Downstream this combines with the Stacks 04KU substrate
363	`GeometricallyConnected (IdentityComponent G).hom` plus Mathlib's

367	group-structure inheritance argument in `isSubgroupHomomorphism`. -/
368	private instance identityComponent_connectedSpace
369	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
370	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
371	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
372	    ConnectedSpace (IdentityComponent G).left := by
373	  change ConnectedSpace ((identityComponentCarrier G : G.left.Opens) : Type _)
374	  infer_instance

376	/-- **Stacks 04KV / EGA IV₂ 4.5.14**: a connected `k`-scheme with a `k`-rational
377	section is geometrically connected.

379	Given a morphism `f : X ⟶ Spec k` from a `ConnectedSpace`-typed scheme `X`
380	admitting a section `s : Spec k ⟶ X` (i.e. `s ≫ f = 𝟙`), the morphism `f` is
381	geometrically connected: for any field extension `K/k`, the pullback
382	`X ×_{Spec k} Spec K` is connected.
383	
384	The Stacks 04KV/037Q descent substrate lives in the sibling module
385	`Picard/GeometricallyConnectedSection.lean` (tensor products of field
386	extensions over an algebraically closed field are domains, together with the
387	open/closed/singleton-fibre clopen descent argument); this lemma is a direct
388	application of it. -/
389	private theorem geometricallyConnected_of_connected_of_section
390	    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
391	    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
392	    (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X) (hsf : s ≫ f = 𝟙 _)
393	    [ConnectedSpace X] :
394	    GeometricallyConnected f :=
395	  geometricallyConnected_of_connectedSpace_of_section f s hsf

397	/-- The range-containment hypothesis for `IsOpenImmersion.lift` used to build
398	the section `identityComponentSection G` below: the image of the identity
399	section `MonObj.one.left : Spec k ⟶ G.left` lies in the carrier of the
400	identity component (a singleton image `{identitySectionPoint G}` contained
401	in `connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G) = identityComponentCarrier G`). -/
402	private lemma identityComponentSection_range_subset
403	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
404	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
405	    Set.range ((MonObj.one (X := G)).left : Spec (.of k) ⟶ G.left).base ⊆
406	      Set.range (identityComponentCarrier G).ι.base := by
407	  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
408	  let f : ↥(Spec (.of k)) → G.left := (MonObj.one (X := G)).left.base
409	  change Set.range f ⊆ _
410	  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
411	  have hx : x = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
412	  rw [hx]
413	  -- `f default = identitySectionPoint G` (by definition of
414	  -- `identitySectionPoint`); the carrier underlying set is
415	  -- `connectedComponent (identitySectionPoint G)`.
416	  exact mem_connectedComponent
417	
418	/-- The **identity section of `G⁰`**: the unit `e : Spec k ⟶ G` of the group
419	scheme `G` factored through the open immersion `G⁰ ↪ G`.
420	
421	The factorisation exists because the image of `e` is the single point
422	`identitySectionPoint G`, which lies in the carrier of `G⁰` by
423	`identityComponentSection_range_subset`. -/
424	noncomputable def identityComponentSection
425	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
426	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
427	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
428	    Spec (.of k) ⟶ (IdentityComponent G).left :=
429	  @IsOpenImmersion.lift (identityComponentCarrier G).toScheme (Spec (.of k))
430	    G.left (identityComponentCarrier G).ι
431	    ((MonObj.one (X := G)).left : Spec (.of k) ⟶ G.left)
432	    inferInstance (identityComponentSection_range_subset G)
433	
434	/-- The **identity section lift is a section of `(IdentityComponent G).hom`**.
435	
436	Composing `identityComponentSection G` with `(IdentityComponent G).hom`
437	returns the identity on `Spec k`, by `IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac` plus the
438	over-compatibility `MonObj.one.left ≫ G.hom = 𝟙` (the terminal of
439	`Over (Spec k)` has `.hom = 𝟙 (Spec k)` definitionally). -/
440	lemma identityComponentSection_isSection
441	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
442	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
443	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
444	    identityComponentSection G ≫ (IdentityComponent G).hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
445	  -- `(IdentityComponent G).hom = (identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom`
446	  -- (definitionally, by the `IdentityComponent` def).
447	  change identityComponentSection G ≫ (identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom = _
448	  rw [← Category.assoc]
449	  -- `identityComponentSection G ≫ (identityComponentCarrier G).ι = MonObj.one.left`
450	  -- by `IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac` (after unfolding the `identityComponentSection`
451	  -- def to expose the `IsOpenImmersion.lift` head).
452	  rw [show identityComponentSection G ≫ (identityComponentCarrier G).ι =
453	        ((MonObj.one (X := G)).left : Spec (.of k) ⟶ G.left) from
454	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ (identityComponentSection_range_subset G)]
455	  -- Now: `(MonObj.one (X := G)).left ≫ G.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))`.
456	  -- This is the over-morphism compatibility: for the terminal of
457	  -- `Over (Spec k)`, `(MonObj.one).w` says
458	  -- `MonObj.one.left ≫ G.hom = (𝟙_).hom = 𝟙 (Spec k)` (defeq).
459	  exact (MonObj.one (X := G)).w
460	
461	/-- The structural morphism `(IdentityComponent G).hom` is **geometrically
462	connected**.
463	
464	This is deliberately stated as a `theorem` and not as an `instance`, so that
465	it is never inserted silently by typeclass search; downstream consumers
466	invoke it explicitly via `letI := identityComponent_geometricallyConnected G`.
467	
468	Derived from:
469	- `identityComponent_connectedSpace`:
470	  `ConnectedSpace (IdentityComponent G).left`.
471	- `identityComponentSection_isSection`: existence of a section
472	  `Spec k ⟶ (IdentityComponent G).left`.
473	- `geometricallyConnected_of_connected_of_section`: the Stacks 04KU bridge
474	  from `Picard/GeometricallyConnectedSection.lean`.
475	
476	Downstream consumers can
477	chain `letI := identityComponent_geometricallyConnected G` with
478	`UniversallyOpen` of `Spec k → Spec k` (which holds via
479	`[IsIntegral Y] [Subsingleton Y] ⟹ UniversallyOpen f`) to derive
480	`ConnectedSpace (pullback (IdentityComponent G).hom g)` for any
481	`g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)` from a `ConnectedSpace Y`. -/
482	private theorem identityComponent_geometricallyConnected
483	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
484	    (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
485	    [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] :
486	    GeometricallyConnected (IdentityComponent G).hom :=
487	  geometricallyConnected_of_connected_of_section
488	    (IdentityComponent G).hom (identityComponentSection G)
489	    (identityComponentSection_isSection G)
490	
491	/-! ### The inherited group structure on `G⁰`
492	
493	Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`~(3)(b): the clopen identity component `G⁰` of a
494	`k`-group scheme `G` locally of finite type inherits the group structure of
495	`G`. Strategy (Yoneda): the subfunctor of `Hom(-, G)` of morphisms whose
496	set-theoretic image lands in the identity-component carrier is a presheaf of
497	*subgroups* — closure under `mul`/`inv` is Kleiman's connectedness argument
498	(`G⁰ ×ₖ G⁰` is connected, via `identityComponent_geometricallyConnected` +
499	Mathlib's connected-pullback instance, so its image under the group law is a
500	connected subset through `e`, hence contained in the connected component).
501	This subfunctor is represented by `IdentityComponent G` (factorisation
502	through the open immersion `G⁰ ↪ G` via `IsOpenImmersion.lift`), so
503	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` equips `IdentityComponent G` with the
504	group-object structure. -/
505	
506	open MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
507	open scoped MonObj
508	
509	section SubgroupStructure
510	
511	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (G : Over (Spec (.of k)))
512	  [GrpObj G] [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]
513	
514	/-- The inclusion `G⁰ ⟶ G` as an over-category morphism (the same underlying
515	open immersion `(identityComponentCarrier G).ι` as in
516	`IdentityComponent.isOpenSubgroupScheme`). -/
517	private noncomputable def identityComponentInclusion : IdentityComponent G ⟶ G :=
518	  Over.homMk (identityComponentCarrier G).ι rfl
519	
520	/-- Composition with a fixed morphism only shrinks the set-theoretic image. -/
521	private lemma range_comp_left_subset {A B C' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C') :
522	    Set.range ⇑(a ≫ b).left ⊆ Set.range ⇑b.left := by
523	  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
524	  exact ⟨a.left.base t, by simp⟩
525	
526	/-- The image of the unit section lands in the identity-component carrier. -/
527	private lemma range_one_left_subset :
528	    Set.range ⇑(MonObj.one (X := G)).left ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left) := by
529	  have h := identityComponentSection_range_subset G
530	  rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at h
531	
532	/-- The image of the inclusion is contained in the identity-component carrier. -/
533	private lemma range_inclusion_left_subset :
534	    Set.range ⇑(identityComponentInclusion G).left ⊆
535	      (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left) := by
536	  change Set.range ⇑(identityComponentCarrier G).ι ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left)
537	  exact (Scheme.Opens.range_ι _).le
538	
539	/-- Range hypothesis for the `IsOpenImmersion.lift` factorisation below. -/
540	private lemma identityComponentFactor_range {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T ⟶ G)
541	    (hf : Set.range ⇑f.left ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left)) :
542	    Set.range ⇑f.left ⊆ Set.range ⇑(identityComponentCarrier G).ι := by
543	  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hf
544	
545	/-- A morphism `T ⟶ G` whose set-theoretic image lands in the
546	identity-component carrier factors through the open immersion `G⁰ ↪ G`. -/
547	private noncomputable def identityComponentFactor {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T ⟶ G)
548	    (hf : Set.range ⇑f.left ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left)) :
549	    T ⟶ IdentityComponent G :=
550	  Over.homMk
551	    (@IsOpenImmersion.lift (identityComponentCarrier G).toScheme T.left G.left
552	      (identityComponentCarrier G).ι f.left inferInstance
553	      (identityComponentFactor_range G f hf))
554	    (by
555	      change _ ≫ (identityComponentCarrier G).ι ≫ G.hom = T.hom
556	      rw [← Category.assoc, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (identityComponentCarrier G).ι f.left
557	        (identityComponentFactor_range G f hf)]
558	      exact Over.w f)
559	
560	private lemma identityComponentFactor_comp {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T ⟶ G)
561	    (hf : Set.range ⇑f.left ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left)) :
562	    identityComponentFactor G f hf ≫ identityComponentInclusion G = f := by
563	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
564	  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (identityComponentCarrier G).ι f.left
565	    (identityComponentFactor_range G f hf)
566	
567	/-- The unit of `G`, viewed as a morphism into the identity component. -/
568	private noncomputable def identityComponentOne :
569	    𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ IdentityComponent G :=
570	  Over.homMk (identityComponentSection G) (identityComponentSection_isSection G)
571	
572	private lemma identityComponentOne_comp :
573	    identityComponentOne G ≫ identityComponentInclusion G = MonObj.one (X := G) := by
574	  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
575	  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (identityComponentCarrier G).ι
576	    (MonObj.one (X := G)).left (identityComponentSection_range_subset G)
577	
578	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] in
579	/-- `1 · 1 = 1` in diagrammatic form for the unit object. -/
580	private lemma lift_one_one_mul :
581	    lift (MonObj.one (X := G)) (MonObj.one (X := G)) ≫ MonObj.mul (X := G) =
582	      MonObj.one (X := G) := by
583	  have h1 : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) = MonObj.one (X := G) := by
584	    rw [Hom.one_def, toUnit_unique (toUnit _) (𝟙 _), Category.id_comp]
585	  simpa [Hom.mul_def, h1] using mul_one (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G)
586	
587	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] in
588	/-- The unit is fixed by inversion: `e⁻¹ = e` in diagrammatic form. -/
589	private lemma one_comp_inv :
590	    MonObj.one (X := G) ≫ GrpObj.inv (X := G) = MonObj.one (X := G) := by
591	  simp
592	
593	/-- `G⁰ ×ₖ G⁰` is connected (EGA IV₂ 4.5.8, via geometric connectedness of
594	`G⁰` and universal openness of morphisms to the spectrum of a field). -/
595	private lemma identityComponent_tensor_connectedSpace :
596	    ConnectedSpace (IdentityComponent G ⊗ IdentityComponent G).left := by
597	  letI := identityComponent_geometricallyConnected G
598	  haveI : IsIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
599	  haveI : Subsingleton ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
600	    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
601	  haveI : UniversallyOpen (IdentityComponent G).hom := inferInstance
602	  exact inferInstanceAs
603	    (ConnectedSpace ↥(pullback (IdentityComponent G).hom (IdentityComponent G).hom))
604	
605	/-- **Core closure lemma (mul)**: the image of `G⁰ ×ₖ G⁰` under the group law
606	of `G` is contained in the identity-component carrier (a connected set
607	through the identity point is contained in its connected component). -/
608	private lemma range_tensor_mul_subset :
609	    Set.range ⇑(((identityComponentInclusion G ⊗ₘ identityComponentInclusion G) ≫
610	        MonObj.mul (X := G)).left) ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left) := by
611	  haveI := identityComponent_tensor_connectedSpace G
612	  have hmor : lift (identityComponentOne G) (identityComponentOne G) ≫
613	      ((identityComponentInclusion G ⊗ₘ identityComponentInclusion G) ≫
614	        MonObj.mul (X := G)) = MonObj.one (X := G) := by
615	    rw [← Category.assoc, lift_map, identityComponentOne_comp, lift_one_one_mul]
616	  have hmem : identitySectionPoint G ∈ Set.range ⇑(((identityComponentInclusion G ⊗ₘ
617	      identityComponentInclusion G) ≫ MonObj.mul (X := G)).left) := by
618	    have h0 : identitySectionPoint G ∈ Set.range ⇑(MonObj.one (X := G)).left :=
619	      ⟨(default : ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k))), rfl⟩
620	    rw [← hmor] at h0
621	    exact range_comp_left_subset _ _ h0
622	  have hsub := (isPreconnected_range (Scheme.Hom.continuous _)).subset_connectedComponent hmem

624	
625	/-- **Core closure lemma (inv)**: the image of `G⁰` under the inversion of `G`
626	is contained in the identity-component carrier. -/
627	private lemma range_inclusion_inv_subset :
628	    Set.range ⇑((identityComponentInclusion G ≫ GrpObj.inv (X := G)).left) ⊆
629	      (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left) := by
630	  have hmor : identityComponentOne G ≫
631	      identityComponentInclusion G ≫ GrpObj.inv (X := G) = MonObj.one (X := G) := by
632	    rw [← Category.assoc, identityComponentOne_comp, one_comp_inv]
633	  have hmem : identitySectionPoint G ∈
634	      Set.range ⇑((identityComponentInclusion G ≫ GrpObj.inv (X := G)).left) := by
635	    have h0 : identitySectionPoint G ∈ Set.range ⇑(MonObj.one (X := G)).left :=
636	      ⟨(default : ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k))), rfl⟩
637	    rw [← hmor] at h0
638	    exact range_comp_left_subset _ _ h0
639	  have hsub := (isPreconnected_range (Scheme.Hom.continuous _)).subset_connectedComponent hmem
640	  simpa [identityComponentCarrier] using hsub
641	
642	/-- The subgroup of `Hom(T, G)` of morphisms landing in the identity-component
643	carrier (Kleiman §5 Lem.~`lem:agps`~(3)(b), Yoneda form). -/
644	private noncomputable def identityComponentSubgroup (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
645	    Subgroup (T ⟶ G) where
646	  carrier := {f | Set.range ⇑f.left ⊆ (identityComponentCarrier G : Set G.left)}
647	  one_mem' := by
648	    change Set.range ⇑(1 : T ⟶ G).left ⊆ _
649	    rw [(Hom.one_def : (1 : T ⟶ G) = _)]
650	    exact (range_comp_left_subset _ _).trans (range_one_left_subset G)
651	  mul_mem' := by
652	    intro f g hf hg
653	    change Set.range ⇑(f * g).left ⊆ _
654	    have hfac : f * g =
655	        lift (identityComponentFactor G f hf) (identityComponentFactor G g hg) ≫
656	          ((identityComponentInclusion G ⊗ₘ identityComponentInclusion G) ≫
657	            MonObj.mul (X := G)) := by
658	      conv_rhs => rw [← Category.assoc, lift_map,
659	        identityComponentFactor_comp G f hf, identityComponentFactor_comp G g hg]
660	      exact Hom.mul_def f g
661	    rw [hfac]
662	    exact (range_comp_left_subset _ _).trans (range_tensor_mul_subset G)
663	  inv_mem' := by
664	    intro f hf
665	    change Set.range ⇑f⁻¹.left ⊆ _
666	    have hfac : f⁻¹ = identityComponentFactor G f hf ≫
667	        (identityComponentInclusion G ≫ GrpObj.inv (X := G)) := by
668	      conv_rhs => rw [← Category.assoc, identityComponentFactor_comp G f hf]
669	      exact Hom.inv_def f
670	    rw [hfac]
671	    exact (range_comp_left_subset _ _).trans (range_inclusion_inv_subset G)
672	
673	/-- The presheaf of groups `T ↦ {f : T ⟶ G | im f ⊆ G⁰}`. -/
674	private noncomputable def identityComponentSubgroupFunctor :
675	    (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ GrpCat.{u} where
676	  obj T := GrpCat.of (identityComponentSubgroup G T.unop)
677	  map {T T'} φ := GrpCat.ofHom
678	    { toFun := fun f => ⟨φ.unop ≫ f.1, (range_comp_left_subset _ _).trans f.2⟩
679	      map_one' := Subtype.ext (by
680	        change φ.unop ≫ (1 : T.unop ⟶ G) = (1 : T'.unop ⟶ G)
681	        simp only [Hom.one_def]
682	        rw [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit])
683	      map_mul' := fun f g => Subtype.ext (by
684	        change φ.unop ≫ (f.1 * g.1) = (φ.unop ≫ f.1) * (φ.unop ≫ g.1)
685	        simp only [Hom.mul_def]
686	        rw [← Category.assoc, comp_lift]) }
687	  map_id T := by
688	    ext f
689	    exact Category.id_comp _
690	  map_comp {T T' T''} φ ψ := by
691	    ext f
692	    exact Category.assoc _ _ _
693	
694	/-- The natural bijection `(T ⟶ G⁰) ≃ {f : T ⟶ G | im f ⊆ G⁰}`. -/
695	private noncomputable def identityComponentHomEquiv (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
696	    (T ⟶ IdentityComponent G) ≃ ↥(identityComponentSubgroup G T) where
697	  toFun u := ⟨u ≫ identityComponentInclusion G,
698	    (range_comp_left_subset _ _).trans (range_inclusion_left_subset G)⟩
699	  invFun f := identityComponentFactor G f.1 f.2
700	  left_inv u := by
